text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mmh... I couldn't run the way I wanted to...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It felt like the me inside my head
and the me actually running had completely decoupled...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know full well I gotta do something about it,
but... what in the world should I do?
choice_data_list: All we can do is take it one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? If you say so, Trainer,
then maybe it is, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Indeed.
Moping around won't get us anywhere, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's build up your strong points even more.
And with that, we'll definitely seize victory next time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Step by step, doing what I can... huh.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Doing nothing just because you don't understand
will only invite the exact same outcome.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the pickles, and you're the pickling stone, Trainer.
Don't go easy on me—press down hard and pack in the training."
